bug_semantics: AbstractIoBuffer.getObject() deserializes untrusted Java native serialization streams. The CVE-2024-52046 classname allowlist (acceptMatchers) was applied too late: readClassDescriptor() still executed Class.forName(className, true, classLoader) before any matcher check, so a disallowed class's static initializer could already have run; resolveClass() then consulted acceptMatchers only after ObjectStreamClass.forClass() was already non-null. CVE-2026-41409 moved that check earlier on 2.0.X only. 2.1.11 and 2.2.6 shipped without that early-allowlist patch, so 2.1.x through 2.1.11 and 2.2.x through 2.2.6 remained exploitable via IoBuffer.getObject() (CWE-502, CVSS 9.8).
